acceptance.given: Disposable, contained package variants constructed to produce one diagnostic and progressively more diagnostic-producing defects, with an independent finite diagnostics limit frozen before formal RED rather than read from candidate-controlled policy.

oracle.expected: Both entrypoints return a diagnostics list whose length never exceeds the independently frozen finite limit, including when additional defects exceed that limit. Every returned diagnostic contains rule, path, and message fields. The single-defect variant produces a nonempty list, preventing an unconditional empty result from satisfying the checks.
forbidden: The diagnostics list grows beyond the frozen finite limit.
Any returned diagnostic lacks rule, path, or message.
An unconditional pass or empty diagnostics result satisfies the diagnostic-producing cases.
The test derives its expected limit or required fields from candidate-controlled production policy.
A missing production import, absent test, timeout, or environment failure is classified as causal RED.

Check list length against the independently frozen limit and inspect every returned entry for rule, path, and message; runtime result inspection is the evaluation phase for this output-structure constraint.

acceptance.when: The planned test_a06 directly calls scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package and invokes the real CLI with subprocess argv on the diagnostic-producing variants, including variants exceeding the frozen diagnostics limit.
